Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of XOM.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.53 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 46 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Our gross margin expanded by 46 basis points to 55.2%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $16.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $1.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Revenue guidance of $16.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
